{{Quote|That's your ship?''"<br />"''Yes.''"<br />"''Are there any other Jedi on board.''"<br />"''No.''"<br />"''Very well.|an Aqualish officer and Dorsk 82, before blowing up the ship with Hhen on board|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest" />}}
'''Hhen''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and flew during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest" />

While attempting to rescue [[Droid/Legends|droids]] from an angry mob on [[Ando/Legends|Ando]], Hhen was killed when an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Unidentified Aqualish officer|officer]] blew up the ship in order to trap [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Dorsk 82]] and appease the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. Dorsk 82, who had been in route to Ando, was killed shortly after.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest" />
